headline: Aequs Limited Monitoring Agency Report for Pre-IPO Placement and IPO (Q1 FY27)
sum: Aequs Limited submitted its Q1 FY27 Monitoring Agency Report to NSE, detailing the utilisation of IPO and Pre-IPO Placement proceeds. The filing confirms ongoing compliance with fund deployment conditions post-listing.
detail: Aequs Limited, an aerospace and defence precision engineering company, filed its Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 with NSE. This quarterly submission is a regulatory requirement under SEBI's ICDR Regulations post-listing, tracking the utilisation of capital raised through the Pre-IPO Placement and Initial Public Offering. The report provides transparency to investors and regulators on whether IPO proceeds are being deployed in line with the stated objects of the issue.
